channel.title: The Renewal of Acid Jazz in the UK: 2026 Artists, Concerts, Albums, and the Return of Groove-Led Live Culture
channel.description: The UK acid jazz renewal in 2026 is visible in Acid Jazz Records releases, Bangs & Talbot, Brand New Heavies with Galliano, James Taylor Quartet at Ronnie Scott’s, Mostly Jazz Funk & Soul Festival, and the broader UK jazz scene’s renewed appetite for groove, soul, funk and dance-floor musicianship.
